text:
Charle-Edouard D'Astous never heard his name called at a draft. He went from Rimouski to the SHL (39 points in 49 games for Brynäs in 2024-25) to Tampa Bay, and now he's playing 19 minutes a night and quarterbacking a power play. Six of his 11 points have come with the man advantage, and he has ten points in his last ten games.

Our numbers call the hot run earned, with a caveat. His ice time is up 4:17 a night in that stretch, which explains a lot, and his own chances have risen too. But 12.5 percent shooting for a defenseman is double his usual range, and 2.51 points per 60 is far above anything in his talent range (1.19 to 1.83).

Evolving-Hockey liked his play-driving last season (86th percentile among defensemen for chances created). Expect fewer points per game, but the role looks secure. The fantasy sites have noticed; the 24:36 he played in Minnesota says the coaches have too.
headline: D'Astous went undrafted and is running Tampa's power play
